help_castle.title: 🏰 Guide: Castle Battle
help_castle.subtitle: Assault simulation on the center of power and turrets.
help_castle.sec1Desc:
Use the top switch to change mode at any time:

Static Map: Works like a chessboard. Freely drag players on the map to study visual formations without time calculations.
Dynamic Map: Activates the real game engine. Here players are locked in their starting coordinates and you can use the time slider to track marches towards targets.
help_castle.sec2Desc:
Click on 🛠️ Builder on the right. From here you can divide the Alliance into Macro-groups (e.g. 'Central Castle', 'North Turret') and create Assault Teams.

Assign the role of Rally Leader or Defense Captain: on the map, these players will have a solid marker, while support members (Fillers) will be semi-transparent to keep the map clean.
help_castle.sec3Desc:
If your strategy requires gathering the best players from different guilds, use Phase 3 of the Builder.

Assign each team the 'Alliance Tag' where they must be on the day of the event. The system will analyze each player's origin and automatically compile the exact list of who must 'fly' (transfer) and to where.
help_castle.sec4Desc:
In Dynamic Map, click on a player to open the orders panel. Choose the target and march type (Attack, Defense, Support or Rally).

Launch Rally: The system will automatically add the 5 minutes of preparation to the geometric travel time. All confirmed orders will populate the Timeline on the right, showing you to the exact second who will arrive first and who later.
help_castle.sec5Desc:
Once the plan is finished, you won't have to copy anything by hand. Click on Export Chat Texts to open the Report generator.

You will find perfectly formatted text blocks ready to be pasted on Discord or WhatsApp, divided into: Positions (for members), Orders (for Leaders), Flights (for transfers) and General Timeline.

help_tactical.title: ⚔️ Guide: Free Tactical Room
help_tactical.subtitle: Strategic planning on an open map.
help_tactical.sec1Desc:
Use the top switch:

Markers Only (Static): Place and freely move members to create visual defensive or offensive schemes.
Orders & Buildings (Dynamic): Activate routes, travel calculations, and the time machine to simulate impacts and interceptions.
help_tactical.sec2Desc: Click on 🛠️ Builder. Create tactical groups and assign roles. This allows you to manage complex macro-formations and distribute them on the field easily, balancing the Power of each team with one click.
help_tactical.sec3Desc: Are you organizing a joint operation between multiple guilds? Use Phase 3 of the Builder to set the final destination of each team. The simulator will generate the necessary transfer lists for the players.
help_tactical.sec4Desc: Click a player on the map to order Attacks or Rallies on specific coordinates or buildings. Every single move is recorded and timed in the Timeline tab, allowing you to calibrate synchronized attacks to the millisecond.
help_tactical.sec5Desc: Click Export Chat Texts at the bottom right. You will get a professional text report, divided into Positions, Flights, and Timeline, ready to share with your alliance or your officers.

help_alliance.title: 🛡️ Guide: Hive Management
help_alliance.subtitle: Organize the territory and base layout.
help_alliance.sec1Desc: Turn on the Holographic Grid from the left menu. Enter the X and Y coordinates of your Headquarters and set the Radius: you will see a safe zone appear on the map representing the actual alliance territory.
help_alliance.sec2Desc: You can drag the HQ or Bear Traps directly onto the map to define the main gathering points. Use the X and Y fields in the sidebar for absolute precision.
help_alliance.sec3Desc: Search for members in the left bar and drag them into the grid, or type their coordinates. This way you will see at a glance who is outside the security perimeter, who is exposed to attacks, and who is too far from the traps for the event.
help_alliance.sec4Desc: If your territory has an irregular shape, use the Territory Boundaries block. Add the various points (X/Y Vertices) to draw a custom polygon on the map that exactly traces the blue area of the game.

help_global.title: 🌍 Guide: Global Map
help_global.subtitle: Explore databases and calculate distances.
help_global.sec1Desc: Navigate by dragging the map and using zoom. Use the Building Filters menu on the left to turn on or off entire categories (Sanctuaries, Fortresses, Guilds, etc.). The fewer elements on screen, the smoother the map will be.
help_global.sec2Desc: Select the March Times tool from the menu. Click on any two points on the map (or type the coordinates): the system will instantly tell you the exact geometric distance in tiles and the standard travel time needed to cover it.
help_global.sec3Desc: Accessible only via Master Password. Allows server administrators to correct the exact coordinates of buildings or alter Hitboxes (Click areas). Changes saved here will change the map for all users of the Kingdom.

viking_simulator.title: Sequential Queue Engine (Wave Cap)
viking_simulator.tooltip_desc: The simulator processes attacks by class. If the wave depletes before a class attacks, remaining troops will score 0 kills.
viking_simulator.rule_1: This engine replicates the real combat algorithm of the game based on three golden rules:
viking_simulator.rule_2: Zero-Sum Pool: You cannot kill more enemies than actually spawned in the wave.
viking_simulator.rule_3: Class Queue: Attacks are not simultaneous, but happen in order: Infantry → Cavalry → Archers.
viking_simulator.rule_4: Spillover: If the enemy "Cap" is reached during a class's turn (e.g., Infantry), subsequent classes will have no available targets, scoring 0 kills (Host zero-kill phenomenon).
viking_simulator.thermometer_desc: This table compares the mathematical prediction of the simulator with the real kills registered by the Alliance. If a wave was not played, the prediction is based on the rally composition selected above.

viking_tier_efficiency.title: 📈 Real Tier Efficiency by Troop Type
viking_tier_efficiency.description: Analysis based on synchronous maximum peaks of the event. Extreme jumps between low and high Tiers are due to Survived Waves: players with high Tiers survive longer and gather the massive enemy pool of the final phases.

modals.helpSubtitle: Everything you need to know to dominate Tri-Alliance.
modals.helpSec1Desc: Each player has 3 Marches available (the 3 green dots).
modals.helpSec1Li1: Drag & Drop: Click and hold a player on the left bar and drag them to a building.
modals.helpSec1Li2: Quick Move: Drag an already assigned player from one building to another to move them instantly.
modals.helpSec1Li3: Marches reset and are calculated independently for each Phase (1, 2, and 3).
modals.helpSec2Desc: To avoid confusion, divide players into Colored Teams.
modals.helpSec2Li1: Click on 'Advanced' and then Create / Edit Teams.
modals.helpSec2Li2: When you assign players, the building will color proportionally based on the teams inside!
modals.helpSec3Desc: Draw tactical routes to indicate movements.
modals.helpSec3Li1: Click 'Draw Paths' on the left bar.
modals.helpSec3Li2: Click a starting building and then the destination. The app will calculate the road.
modals.helpSec3Li3: To remove an arrow, click on it (it turns orange) and press Del (or Backspace).
modals.helpSec4Desc: When the map is too crowded, use visual filters:
modals.helpSec4Li1: Eye (Radar): Click the 👁️ icon. The map will darken, lighting up only their position.
modals.helpSec4Li2: Hide Troops: Bottom right button. Turns thick markers into thin rings.
modals.helpSec4Li3: Hide Paths: Bottom right button. Hides the arrows.
modals.helpSec5Desc: The game spawns the alliance in one of the 3 bases randomly.
modals.helpSec5Li1: If you plan for the South Base (A) but end up in the North-East Base (B), click 'Rotate Map'.
modals.helpSec5Li2: In a millisecond, the entire plan will rotate 120° adapting to the new start!
modals.helpSec6Desc: Once the plan is done, click 'Export Dossier'. You can:
modals.helpSec6Li1: Copy the order timeline with one click to paste in guild chats.
modals.helpSec6Li2: Click Print Dossier / Save PDF to generate the tactical PDF.
modals.helpFooter: Developed to win. Good luck Commander! ⚔️

map_help.title: 📖 General Tactical Manual
map_help.subtitle: Everything you need to manage the Map and the Castle.
map_help.sec1Desc: The global map simulates the battlefield in 1:1 scale.
map_help.sec1Li1: Zoom and Pan: Drag with the mouse to move. Use the scroll wheel (or +/- buttons) to zoom.
map_help.sec1Li2: Building Filters: In the 'Select Action' menu, use filters to hide or show specific categories (Sanctuaries, Turrets, etc.) to keep the map clean.
map_help.sec2Desc: How to assign troops to buildings:
map_help.sec2Li1: Drag & Drop: From the left bar (Teams tab), drag a player's card directly onto a building on the map.
map_help.sec2Li2: Order Type: Clicking on a building opens the right panel. Here you can specify if the march is an Attack, Defense, or a Rally.
map_help.sec2Li3: Withdraw Troops: Use the ✕ button next to the player's name to cancel the order.
map_help.sec3Desc: The heart of the simulator is time control.
map_help.sec3Li1: Slider: Use the bottom bar to travel through the 60 minutes of the event.
map_help.sec3Li2: March Times: The system automatically calculates the geometric distance between the Castle and the Allies, calculating the exact second of impact.
map_help.sec3Li3: In the Timeline tab on the left, you will see the exact chronological order of departure and arrival of every single march.
map_help.sec4Desc: Want to know how long it takes a troop to get from A to B?
map_help.sec4Li1: Select the March Time tool from the menu.
map_help.sec4Li2: Click on a starting point and then the target: the app will tell you the exact distance in tiles and the travel time.
map_help.sec5Li1: Activate the Holographic Grid to visualize the headquarters' radius.
map_help.sec5Li2: Assign X and Y coordinates to members to see exactly who is out of position or far from the center.

swordland_manual.title: Tactical Manual
swordland_manual.sec1_desc: The map is your planning table. Players are represented by 👤 markers.
swordland_manual.sec1_li1: Drag & Drop: Drag a marker anywhere on the map to "Teleport" that player's base.
swordland_manual.sec1_li2: Auto-Retreat: If you teleport a player, all their active marches and garrisons will be instantly canceled and the troops will become available again.
swordland_manual.sec2_desc: Click on a 👤 marker to open the Orders Modal. From here you can assign a destination and an action:
swordland_manual.sec2_li1: ⚔️ Attack / Garrison: Send a single troop to a Building.
swordland_manual.sec2_li2: 🚩 Rally: Allows you to invite allies. You can choose a quick Rally (1 Minute) or Standard (4 Minutes). If an ally is too far, a red warning will appear.
swordland_manual.sec2_li3: ⚡ Speedups: Use the lightning button to apply speedups (-25% time) to allies arriving late to the Rally.
swordland_manual.sec2_li4: ⛏️ Gather: Select a Diamond 💎 on the map to send the troop to collect it.
swordland_manual.sec2_warning: Warning: After pressing "SEND ORDERS", you must advance the time in the bottom bar and press "SAVE MINUTE" to actually move the troops on the map.
swordland_manual.sec3_li1: Padlock 🔒: Some buildings are not available from minute 0. The system will block marches trying to arrive before the opening time.
swordland_manual.sec3_li2: Capture: You need to garrison the building alone for 3 Minutes (or 1.5 Minutes if your team owns the Bell Tower).
swordland_manual.sec3_li3: Withdraw Troops: Click on a controlled building to open the management panel. You can withdraw a single player or empty the entire garrison by pressing 🚩 WITHDRAW TROOPS.
swordland_manual.sec3_li4: Point Theft 📦: If an enemy captures your building, your team will lose 50% of the points accumulated in that session. Those points will turn into 5 Diamonds 💎 dropping on the map, ready to be gathered!
swordland_manual.sec4_li1: Heal: From the Orders Modal you can send a player to the Hospital. They will disappear from the map for 12 Minutes, losing all active marches.
swordland_manual.sec4_li2: Tactical Radar 📡: Also from the Orders Modal, the "Deployed Units" panel shows you exactly where all the player's marches are in that specific minute (traveling, in garrison, or retreating to base).
